description: An Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level playful editorial blog. Mixes high-end editorial layouts with Neo-Brutalist bold borders, vibrant color blocking, and smooth momentum scrolling.

headings.rules: Use font-semibold to font-bold. Always apply tight tracking (tracking-tighter) and tight leading (leading-none). Used for Hero, Article Titles.

body.rules: Use for paragraphs, metadata, and buttons. leading-relaxed.

accents.rules: Use exclusively for massive manifesto numbers (01, 02) and marquee text.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use hard, structural borders: border-2 border-[#1A1A1A] for cards, buttons, and section dividers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use sharp, unblurred offset shadows for cards and buttons: shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_#1A1A1A]. On hover, translate the element and reduce the shadow to 4px.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Mix strict rectangles with fully rounded pills (rounded-full) for tags, badges, and primary buttons.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the viewport with pointer-events-none opacity-[0.03] to opacity-[0.05] to remove the digital flatness.

grids_layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. Sections should have py-24 or py-32. Container padding px-6 md:px-12.
grids_layouts.articles_grid: Mode A: Tetris Grid. md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. First featured article col-span-12 md:col-span-8, secondary col-span-12 md:col-span-4. Row spans should vary to create an asymmetric, masonry-like feel without actually using masonry.

component_guidelines.hero: Kinetic Hero: Full viewport height (min-h-[90vh]). Massive text 'Colorat & Jucăuș'. Use framer-motion for line-by-line masked reveal (overflow-hidden wrapper around text that translates Y from 100% to 0). Include floating editorial images with parallax effect driven by scroll.
component_guidelines.article_cards: Editorial photography clipped inside containers with border-2 border-[#1A1A1A] and sharp offset shadows. The image inside scales up on hover via CSS transform (scale-105). Tags should be pill-shaped with vibrant background colors.
component_guidelines.manifesto_chapters: Numbered sections stacked vertically. Use massive typography for numbers ('01', '02') using Cabinet Grotesk text-[15vw] to text-[20vw] in brand_blue, brand_pink, or brand_yellow. Text content should overlap the numbers slightly.
component_guidelines.editorial_marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow (speed=20). Font: Cabinet Grotesk, massive size, alternating between filled text and text-stroke (text-transparent webkit-text-stroke).
component_guidelines.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism over the solid background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F4F1EA]/90 border-b-2 border-[#1A1A1A]), or a floating pill navigation fixed at the top.
component_guidelines.newsletter: Neo-brutalist form. Thick borders around the input field, sharp offset shadow for the submit button, vibrant brand_yellow background for the section.
component_guidelines.single_article_view: Clean, highly legible reading mode. Narrow max-width container (max-w-3xl) for text, huge full-bleed images, drop caps for the first letter of the article.

motion.scrolling: MUST use @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is critical for the premium editorial feel.
motion.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion for whileInView effects. Elements should slide up slightly (y: 40 to 0) with a spring transition.
motion.hover_effects: Cards and Buttons: translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] and change shadow to [4px_4px_0px_0px_#1A1A1A]. Image scales 105% inside its container.

image_urls.description: Red and blue abstract object on pink background. Perfect for floating parallax in the hero.
Woman in pink and green dress with sunglasses.
Woman in red fabric in a park.
Person sitting in front of colorful windowed building.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use generic typography (Inter, Roboto). Use the provided Fontshare links in index.css.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, article cards).
Build the hero with a min-height and implement a masked line-by-line text reveal using framer-motion.
Do NOT use pure black or white for major structural elements. Use the defined #F4F1EA background and #1A1A1A text.
Implement the 'offset shadow' look for buttons and cards using Tailwind arbitrary values, e.g., shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_#1A1A1A].
Ensure the navigation header is either completely solid with a bottom border or crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F4F1EA]/80 border-b-2 border-[#1A1A1A]). DO NOT make it transparent.
Keep all files as .js/.jsx, do not use TypeScript.
Create a cohesive single-page-like experience or app routing that transitions between the Hero, Articles Grid, Manifesto Chapters, and Newsletter.
Use framer-motion's useScroll and useTransform hooks to create parallax elements in the hero and manifesto sections.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
